correctness.rationale: For the normalized reversible spectral measure, \\(\rho_1\\) and \\(\rho_2\\) are the first two moments. Cauchy--Schwarz applied to the exact factorization of \\(1+\lambda\\) yields the claimed lower bound. Equality conditions force support on \\(\{-1,q\}\\), and the moment equations determine both \\(q\\) and its mass. The explicit four-state symmetric kernel realizes all feasible pairs, while recalibrated lazification proves the finite aperiodic sharp infimum.

value.rationale: Asymptotic variance directly controls Monte Carlo error and effective sample size in reversible MCMC. The result gives the exact best possible lower guarantee from the two most accessible autocorrelations, strictly strengthens the one-lag bound when the lag-two moment is nondegenerate, and completely characterizes equality and aperiodic sharpness. This is a natural constrained spectral-moment classification rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
